_comment: Design tokens for PRAS Consulting, mirrored from the 'D · Silicon (dark)' hero on the PRAS Landing Hero canvas and its Apple-grade design system. app/src/index.css copies these values into CSS variables and shadcn's semantic tokens. Direction: a black ground, Inter Tight display over Inter body, and one copper accent — flat for buttons and links, as a gradient only on display type and the chip. Pinned to dark.
_paletteNote: On #000: ink #F5F5F7 19.3, muted #A1A1A6 8.0, copper #F0A868 10.3. #1D1D1F on copper (buttons) 9.0. Hairlines #2C2C2E are decorative only.
